selection.name: 덤벨 스퀴즈 프레스
selection.pose_description: Lying on a flat bench, holding two dumbbells PRESSED TOGETHER over center of chest throughout the upward press; show dumbbells touching.

selection.name: 리어 델토이드 플라이 머신
selection.pose_description: Seated facing chest pad of reverse pec deck, hands on handles in front, opening arms sideways backward.

selection.name: 리버스 바벨 컬
selection.pose_description: Standing, elbows beside ribs, bending elbows to curl load upward. Palms-down grip maintained. Use equipment: barbell. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 글루트 브릿지
selection.pose_description: Lying on back on floor, knees bent, feet planted, lifting hips without a bench.

selection.name: 인클라인 벤치프레스 머신
selection.pose_description: Seated reclined in an incline chest press MACHINE, pressing handles upward and forward along an incline path, not a decline path.

selection.name: 이지바 프론트 레이즈
selection.pose_description: Standing, raising load FORWARD to shoulder height with softly bent elbows. Use equipment: EZ curl bar. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 캡틴스 체어 니 레이즈
selection.pose_description: Forearms supported on captain chair pads, torso upright, raising bent knees. Use equipment: captains chair. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 덤벨 레터럴 런지
selection.pose_description: Wide lateral step, bending stepping-leg knee while other leg remains straight. Use equipment: two dumbbells. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 로우 풀리 케이블 플라이
selection.pose_description: Standing between two LOW cable pulleys, lifting handles upward and inward from hip height toward upper chest. Use equipment: cable machine, two handles. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 비하인드 넥 프레스
selection.pose_description: Barbell press from behind head, bar near upper trapezius, elbows below wrists, pressing upward. Do not render bar in front of face.

selection.name: 덤벨 스파이더 컬
selection.pose_description: Prone chest supported on incline bench, upper arms hanging vertically, curling load with palms up. Use two dumbbells.

selection.name: 라잉 힙 어브덕션
selection.pose_description: Lying on side, lifting upper straight leg sideways upward.

selection.name: 아처 푸시업
selection.pose_description: Wide floor push-up shifted toward one bent elbow while opposite arm stays straight sideways. Use equipment: floor. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 스미스머신 슈러그
selection.pose_description: Standing within Smith frame, straight arms holding guided bar in front of thighs, shrugging shoulders upward.

selection.name: 리버스 바벨 리스트 컬
selection.pose_description: Seated with forearms supported on thighs, only wrists curling load upward. Palms down, wrists extending upward. Use equipment: barbell, bench. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 복근 크런치 머신
selection.pose_description: Seated in abdominal crunch machine, torso flexing forward against padded resistance with pelvis stable.

selection.name: 어시스트 딥스 머신
selection.pose_description: On parallel dip handles of assisted dip machine, knees on moving assistance pad, bending elbows to lower torso.

selection.name: 플레이트 숄더 프레스
selection.pose_description: Standing holding ONE weight plate with both hands at chest, pressing plate overhead.

selection.name: 덤벨 스쿼트
selection.pose_description: Both feet planted, bending knees and hips with neutral spine. One dumbbell in each hand at sides. Use equipment: two dumbbells. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 플러터 킥
selection.pose_description: Lying on back, straight legs alternating small up-down movements above floor.

selection.name: 클랩 푸시업
selection.pose_description: Explosive floor push-up, hands momentarily off floor clapping in front of chest, toes on floor. Use equipment: floor. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 라잉 Y 레이즈
selection.pose_description: Prone on floor, arms diagonally extended overhead in a Y and lifted slightly off floor, no weights.

selection.name: 덤벨 인클라인 킥백
selection.pose_description: Chest supported face-down on incline bench, upper arms beside torso, extending elbows backward. Use equipment: two dumbbells, incline bench. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 덤벨 스탠딩 카프 레이즈
selection.pose_description: Standing with knees straight, rising onto balls of feet by lifting heels. Use equipment: two dumbbells. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 스포토 벤치프레스
selection.pose_description: Flat barbell bench press paused with bar a few centimeters above chest without touching it.

selection.name: 이지바 업라이트 로우
selection.pose_description: Standing, pulling load vertically close to torso with elbows rising out to sides. Use equipment: EZ curl bar. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 노르딕 햄스트링 컬
selection.pose_description: Kneeling with ankles secured, torso and thighs straight, lowering entire body forward by extending knees without bending hips.

selection.name: 할로우 포지션
selection.pose_description: Lying on back with lower back pressed to floor, straight arms overhead and straight legs raised slightly off floor. Use equipment: floor. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 인클라인 케이블 플라이
selection.pose_description: Lying on an incline bench between cable columns, opening arms wide then bringing cable handles together above upper chest. Use equipment: cable machine, incline bench, two handles. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 프리쳐 컬 머신
selection.pose_description: Seated with upper arms resting on angled preacher pad, bending elbows against machine lever handles.

selection.name: 벨트 스쿼트 머신
selection.pose_description: Standing on belt squat platform, load suspended from belt around pelvis, squatting with no bar on shoulders.

selection.name: 토르소 로테이션 머신
selection.pose_description: Seated with thighs secured in torso rotation machine, torso rotating against padded upper-body support.

selection.name: 시티드 딥스 머신
selection.pose_description: Seated upright in dip machine with hands on handles beside hips, pushing handles DOWN by extending elbows.

selection.name: 케이블 사이드 벤드
selection.pose_description: Standing upright, holding resistance in one hand at side, bending torso sideways without rotating. Use equipment: low cable pulley, single handle. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 덤벨 원레그 데드리프트
selection.pose_description: Standing hip hinge, neutral back, lowering load close to legs and extending hips. Balance on ONE leg while the other leg extends backward. Use equipment: two dumbbells. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 파이어 하이드런트
selection.pose_description: On hands and knees, lifting one bent knee sideways without rotating torso.

selection.name: 핸드스탠드 푸시업
selection.pose_description: Inverted handstand with both palms on floor, bending elbows to lower head toward floor, legs vertically overhead.

selection.name: 덤벨 프론트 스쿼트
selection.pose_description: Both feet planted, bending knees and hips with neutral spine. Load held in FRONT of shoulders. Use equipment: two dumbbells. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 케이블 킥백
selection.pose_description: Standing facing low pulley, ankle cuff on working leg, extending leg backward while torso remains supported.

selection.name: 토즈투 바
selection.pose_description: Hanging from bar, raising both straight legs until toes approach the bar. Use equipment: pull-up bar. Full body and equipment visible.
